name: Go API Server CI/CD
description: Full pipeline: lint + build -> test + security scan -> package -> deploy with artifact passing

steps.name: format-check
steps.cmd: echo '[lint] checking formatting... all files formatted'

steps.name: write-report
steps.cmd: mkdir -p reports && echo 'Lint Report' > reports/lint.txt && echo '---------' >> reports/lint.txt && echo 'format: pass' >> reports/lint.txt && echo 'vet:     pass' >> reports/lint.txt && echo 'issues:  0' >> reports/lint.txt

steps.name: compile
steps.cmd: mkdir -p bin/dist && printf '#!/bin/sh\necho "server v1.0.0 running on port 8080"\n' > bin/dist/server-linux-amd64 && chmod +x bin/dist/server-linux-amd64 && echo '[build] compiled bin/dist/server-linux-amd64'

steps.name: run-tests
steps.cmd: mkdir -p reports && echo '=== Test Results ===' > reports/test-results.txt && echo 'PASS: TestHello' >> reports/test-results.txt && echo 'PASS: TestConfig' >> reports/test-results.txt && echo 'PASS: TestRoutes' >> reports/test-results.txt && echo 'PASS: TestMiddleware' >> reports/test-results.txt && echo '---' >> reports/test-results.txt && echo '4 passed, 0 failed' >> reports/test-results.txt

steps.name: coverage
steps.cmd: echo 'coverage: 87.3%' > reports/coverage.txt && echo '[unit-test] wrote test-results.txt and coverage.txt'

steps.name: write-report
steps.cmd: mkdir -p reports && echo 'Security Scan Report' > reports/security.txt && echo '---------------------' >> reports/security.txt && echo 'vulnerabilities: 0' >> reports/security.txt && echo 'severity: clean' >> reports/security.txt && echo '[security] wrote security.txt'

steps.name: verify-reports
steps.cmd: echo '=== Verifying all upstream artifacts ===' && cat reports/lint.txt && echo '' && cat reports/test-results.txt && echo '' && cat reports/coverage.txt && echo '' && cat reports/security.txt

steps.name: create-release
steps.cmd: mkdir -p release && tar -cf release/release.tar bin/dist/server-linux-amd64 reports/ && echo '[package] created release/release.tar'

steps.name: checksum
steps.cmd: sha256sum release/release.tar > release/checksum.txt && echo '[package] wrote release/checksum.txt' && cat release/checksum.txt

steps.name: verify-checksum
steps.cmd: echo '[deploy] verifying checksum...' && sha256sum release/release.tar && cat release/checksum.txt && echo '[deploy] checksum OK'

steps.name: extract
steps.cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/deploy && tar -xf release/release.tar -C /tmp/deploy && echo '[deploy] extracted release:' && ls -la /tmp/deploy/bin/dist/ && ls -la /tmp/deploy/reports/
